name: Government Accountability Office
notes: US citizens only for the unpaid student volunteer positions; paid internships state no citizenship rule
evidence: Student volunteers: applicants must be a U.S. citizen, at least 16, attending an accredited school

name: Congressional Budget Office
notes: Non-citizens may be employed only if they meet the criteria in 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)(B)
evidence: CBO can employ people who are not U.S. citizens if they meet the criteria in 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3)(B)

name: Library of Congress
notes: Citizenship rule varies by programme; the Junior Fellows Program is for US citizens only
evidence: Junior Fellows Program: U.S. citizen only; currently enrolled or graduated between January 1, 2025 and December 31, 2025

name: Congressional Research Service
notes: Volunteer internships and law clerk positions are for US citizens only
evidence: Volunteer Internship Program: Applicants must be U.S. citizens

name: U.S. Senate (internships)
notes: Citizenship criteria apply to paid Senate personal office internships only; unpaid internships are not subject to them
evidence: These citizenship criteria and employment authorization requirements apply only to paid internships, and do not apply to unpaid internships.

name: Securities and Exchange Commission
notes: US citizens only
evidence: Applicants must be U.S. Citizens.

name: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
Federal Trade Commission
notes: US citizens only
evidence: Candidates must be U.S. citizens to be eligible for employment.

name: Federal Communications Commission
notes: US citizens only on the agency-wide Student Internships page; individual bureau pages differ
evidence: U.S. citizenship is required for paid and unpaid internships.

name: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
notes: US citizens only
evidence: Pathways Internship eligibility: U.S. citizen or U.S. national, currently enrolled, minimum 2.5 GPA

name: Federal Housing Finance Agency
notes: US citizens; non-citizens who are permanent residents or authorized to work may also be appointed
evidence: Must be a U.S Citizen (FHFA may also appoint non-citizens that are permanent residents or authorized to work)

name: Export-Import Bank of the United States
notes: US citizens only for the unpaid Student Volunteer Internship Program
evidence: Student Volunteer Internship Program brochure lists U.S. citizenship as a requirement

name: U.S. International Trade Commission
notes: US citizens only
evidence: The applicant must be a U.S. citizen, be a student at an accredited, four-year university at the time of the internship

name: Office of the United States Trade Representative
notes: US citizens only
evidence: citizens, at least 18 years or older before the first day of the program, and meet at least one of the three following criteria

name: National Aeronautics and Space Administration
notes: US citizens only for the OSTEM internships
evidence: citizen to be eligible to participate

name: National Institutes of Health
notes: US citizens and permanent residents only
evidence: To apply for the NIH SIP and SIP subprograms in Summer 2027, you must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident.

name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
notes: US citizens or nationals only; graduated within the past two years or on track to graduate in Fall 2026
evidence: Citizen or National to apply for this position

name: Health Resources and Services Administration
notes: US citizens, nationals, permanent residents or others authorized to be employed
evidence: Be a U.S. citizen, or national, or lawfully admitted to the United States as a permanent resident or otherwise authorized to be employed

name: Department of Health and Human Services
notes: US citizens only for the Pathways Internship
evidence: HHS Instruction 362-1 lists U.S. citizenship as an eligibility requirement for the Pathways Internship

name: U.S. Forest Service
notes: Citizenship rule varies by programme; some internships are open to permanent residents and certain visa holders
evidence: Develop public service leadership skills through policy and research internships; open to permanent residents and certain visa holders

name: Department of the Interior
notes: US citizens or nationals may apply; Pathways may also appoint lawful permanent residents or others authorized to be employed
evidence: a non-citizen may be appointed to a Pathways Program provided the individual is lawfully admitted to the United States as a permanent resident or is otherwise authorized to be employed

name: U.S. Geological Survey
notes: US citizens only; non-citizens only if eligible to work and no qualified US citizen is available
evidence: internships at USGS are only open to US citizens

name: National Park Service
notes: US citizens and permanent residents only for the Heritage Documentation Programs summer internships; other park programmes differ
evidence: Heritage Documentation Programs summer internships list a U.S. citizen or permanent resident as a requirement for all interns

name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
notes: US citizens only
evidence: Pathways Student Internships: U.S. citizenship is required. Must be a U.S. citizen.

name: Bureau of Land Management
notes: US citizens, nationals and permanent residents only for the Public Lands Corps
evidence: Is a citizen or national of the United States or lawful permanent resident alien of the United States

name: Bureau of Reclamation
notes: US citizens and nationals only
evidence: Regional pages list good academic standing, minimum age 16, and U.S. citizen or national status for Pathways students

name: Department of Transportation
notes: US citizens only
evidence: All Pathways Interns must be U.S. citizens, be at least 16, and be enrolled or accepted for enrollment at least half-time

name: Federal Highway Administration
notes: US citizens only
evidence: Pathways Internship Program: applicants must be a U.S. Citizen and be enrolled at least half-time

name: Federal Transit Administration
notes: US citizens only; security clearance required
evidence: Applicants need U.S. citizenship, enrollment in a degree programme, and the ability to obtain and keep a security clearance

name: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
notes: US citizens only
evidence: Prospective candidates must be U.S. citizens and be enrolled at least half-time as defined by the education institution

name: Maritime Administration
notes: US citizens only; law students who completed one academic year
evidence: Applicants must be a U.S. citizen, have completed one academic year of legal education and be currently enrolled

name: National Transportation Safety Board
notes: US citizens only
evidence: NTSB college internship eligibility table lists U.S. citizenship, 2.5 GPA and enrollment in a degree programme

name: Occupational Safety and Health Administration
notes: Selected applicants must provide proof of citizenship (unpaid student volunteer programme)
evidence: Applicants selected for the program will be required to provide proof of citizenship

name: Department of Housing and Urban Development
notes: US citizens only for the unpaid Student Volunteer Employment Program
evidence: Page states citizenship is required for the unpaid Student Volunteer Employment Program only
